prompt: A 20-second ensemble reveal in the populated factory. Follow worker A for the first 6 seconds. From 6 to 10 seconds arc 90 degrees right around workers A and B, bringing both fully into frame by 10 seconds. Track both from 10 to 15 seconds. From 15 to 18 seconds dolly backward while craning upward, revealing the workers, yellow forklift, steel mezzanine, and loading bay together. Freeze the scene and lock off for the final 2 seconds, holding that wide ensemble frame. Keep a level horizon, smooth motion and clear sightlines; no cut. Supporting technicians remain secondary.
